The first round of tickets are sold out, but the second round will be available today, and @lorenlorosa has the latest.

🚨 @TheRealDrUmar breaks down what happened between him and his estranged daughter who took to social media with claims he hasn’t  been in her life. “every time I try to meet ti see my daughter she never shows up” ➡️ Check out the full interview on @netflix RN!

🚨 As of today, President Trump is deploying ICE agents to airports nationwide to assist during the TSA shortage amid the government shutdown. @mimibrowntv breaks it down during Front Page News, and The Breakfast Club weighs in on the decision.

Cole opens up about his feelings on jumping into the beef in an interview with Nadeska Alexis, and @lorenlorosa has exclusive footage of him digging deeper into how he felt about the Drake & Kendrick beef, being sued by Cam’ron, and more in a sit-down with Cam’ron. Catch the full interview this Wednesday at 5 PM ET on @revolt & @offscriptworldwide!

The fans aren’t letting up either and have been comparing tattoo photos in her newly released music video, deeming 21 Savage the father! Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa .

🗣️ @BigXthaPlugg , @BigGeneral274 , @KevanGotBandz , @iamkainemusic, @rosama_ten7, and @YUNGHOODBCE  came through to promote their N.W.A. inspired '6WA' mixtape, out now — but where did the vision come from? ➡️ Check out the full conversation on @breakfastclubam on @netflix 🎬
